## Checklist / 確認

- [ ] No real cards, personal photos, backups, credentials or signing settings / 実データ・秘密情報なし

- [ ] Protocol/docs/tests updated when applicable / 必要な仕様・説明・テストを更新
- [ ] Added dependencies/artwork have source and license information / 追加素材・依存の出典とライセンス
